tools.name: which_park_today
tools.description: Ranks the four Walt Disney World theme parks for visiting right now, combining live crowd levels, today's forecast and remaining park hours. Returns each park's rank, live average wait, open/close times and a one-line reason. With resort "dlr" it ranks Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure

tools.name: get_live_wait_times
tools.description: Current posted wait times for Walt Disney World attractions plus SupaPark's Real Wait estimate of the actual wait, a low/high range, confidence, and a flag for "ghost" waits that are posted but not real. Refreshes every few minutes during park hours. Disneyland Resort is covered too: park disneyland

tools.name: get_crowd_forecast
tools.description: Day-by-day crowd forecast for one Walt Disney World park: a 0-100 crowd index, a label (low/moderate/high…) and the drivers behind it (holidays, events, school breaks). tools.name: get_dining_drop_odds
tools.description: For hard-to-book Walt Disney World restaurants: how often cancelled reservations reappear ("drops"), the probability of catching one, and the best day-of-week and hour to look. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted but not covered here yet: they return quality_state

tools.description: The Lightning Lane Multi Pass price for a Walt Disney World park on a given date (defaults to today). tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Shows whether this assistant is linked to a SupaPark account, the plan (free, silver or gold) and how alerts are delivered. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

tools.name: list_my_watches
tools.description: Lists the active ride and dining watches (alerts) on the linked SupaPark account, with each watch's id. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

tools.name: watch_ride
tools.description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account for a Walt Disney World ride. kind "lightning_lane": alert when Lightning Lane return times open up (optionally for a specific date). kind "wait_drop": alert when the standby wait drops to threshold_minutes or less. Delivery channel follows the account

tools.name: watch_dining
tools.description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account that fires when a reservation time opens at a Walt Disney World restaurant for the given date and party size (each newly opened time alerts, even if other times were already open). tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Turns off one watch on the linked SupaPark account, by watch id. It can be restored in the SupaPark app. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_live_wait_times · Public sink: get_hardest_dining_reservations · Destructive: get_dining_drop_odds, remove_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_live_wait_times · Public sink: get_hardest_dining_reservations · Destructive: get_dining_drop_odds, remove_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
